notes.drawing: The request's picture: list-bullets' bullets (radius 4 plus the half-stroke, 12 in regular, as Phosphor's) with lines starting 44 to their right, as in list-bullets; four rows 48 apart (56–200), indented 32 per level (0, 1, 2, 0).
notes.fill: As list-bullets-fill: a filled rounded square with the bullets and lines cut out in white, rows 32 apart, indented 20 per level.
notes.bold: The same drawing; the bullets are written as discs of radius 16 (4 plus bold's half-stroke, as list-bullets-bold), because a browser stroking a radius-4 circle at 24 leaves a hole that the compare check counts (the build itself draws both the same).
notes.duotone: Tints the text block, as list-bullets-duotone tints its lines, stepping in to x 120 beside the indented rows.
